title.narrative: Guatemala Mesoamerican Forest IP Project: Securing benefits for the well-being of local communities and the ecosystems of the Maya Forest

description.narrative: Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.

Some of the socio-economic benefits that the project will support are:• Improved livelihoods for local communities:The project focus on supporting community-managed projects and sustainable production practices (Component 1 & 2) will lead to increased income and improved living standards for people living near the Selva Maya forests.Activities like capacity building for forest and biodiversity management (Component 1) will also equip local actors with valuable skills for future similar initiatives.• Sustainable forest management:The project emphasizes protecting primary forests through various activities (Component 1 & 2) which will lead to a more sustainable approach to forestry, potentially creating long-term economic benefits.• Ecotourism potential:Protecting the Selva Maya's biodiversity could enhance the region's ecotourism potential, which has the potential for creating new jobs in the tourism sector and generate income for local communities.• Knowledge sharing and capacity building:The project's collaborative approach (Component 2) with local and international organizations will lead to knowledge sharing and capacity building within communities. This will empower them to manage resources more effectively and contribute to long-term sustainability.• Gender and social inclusion: As the project emphasizes incorporating women, youth, and indigenous peoples, this could ensure a more equitable distribution of project benefits and promote social inclusion.

The objective of the project is to contribute to the protection of critical ecosystems in the prioritised regions of the Department of PetÃ©n, the Selva Maya and the Trifinio area in Guatemala, while improving the well-being of local communities. The projectâ€™s objective will be achieved by i) strengthening governance and protection of natural resources; ii) promoting sustainable forest management, restoration of degraded forest lands and conservation efforts; iii) mobilising funding for sustainable forest management inside and outside protected areas; and iv) promoting regional cooperation and knowledge sharing.
